followups: Global fields must apply to every logx output, including calls made without a context-specific logger. Repeated additions should accumulate fields, and both plain and JSON output should retain the message and its per-call fields.

Add the public logx.AddGlobalFields(fields ...LogField) API in core/logx/fields.go. Keep global field snapshots safe for concurrent readers and serialize additions. Merge global fields with per-call fields in the common output path in core/logx/writer.go before selecting plain or JSON encoding. Preserve the existing behavior when no global fields have been added.

Provide core/logc/logs.go as the context-aware facade for logx. Alias LogConf and LogField; expose Field and AddGlobalFields, logging configuration and lifecycle helpers, and the Error, Info, and Slow families with plain, formatted, structured-value, and field variants. Contextual logging should use logx.WithContext(ctx).WithCallerSkip(1); formatted errors should preserve caller attribution. Delegate Alert, Close, Must, MustSetup, SetLevel, and SetUp to logx. This completes the facade as well as the global-field output behavior.
